articles.title: 3 types of financial guilt and how to cope
articles.summary: 花钱太多会后悔、给家人太少会内疚？理财师劳琳·威廉姆斯把这种情绪归纳为“财务内疚”，并给出三类应对思路。

sentences.en: Ever regretted spending too much on dinner? Or ashamed about not being able to give a family member more financial support?
sentences.zh: 你是否曾后悔在晚餐上花太多钱？或者因为无法给家人更多经济支持而感到羞愧？

sentences.en: There's a term for this feeling, says certified financial planner Lauryn Williams: financial guilt.
sentences.zh: “认证理财规划师劳琳·威廉姆斯说，这种感觉有个名称：财务内疚。”

sentences.en: And it can hold you back from taking steps to fix your finances — or enjoying the money you do have.
sentences.zh: 而它会阻碍你采取行动去改善财务状况——或者享受你已有的钱。

sentences.en: Narratives like "I should have known better" or "I shouldn't be in this situation" don't help, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说，诸如“我本该更明智”或“我不该处于这种境地”这样的内心独白毫无帮助。

sentences.en: "They don't allow you to move forward because you feel so guilty."
sentences.zh: “它们让你裹足不前，因为你感到太内疚了。”

sentences.en: Williams, the founder of the financial planning firm Worth Winning, shares three kinds of financial guilt and how to address them.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯是理财公司 Worth Winning 的创始人，她分享了三种财务内疚的类型以及应对方法。

vocab.zh: 叙述；此处指内心的自我对话

grammar: 口语省略主语："Ever regretted spending too much on dinner?" 是省略了主语 you 的疑问句，regret doing sth 表示“后悔做过某事”。
There be 句型："There's a term for this feeling" 表示“存在这样一种说法/术语”，term for... 意为“……的术语”。
hold back from doing："hold you back from taking steps" 意为“阻碍你采取行动”，from 后接动名词。
虚拟语气 should have done："I should have known better" 表示“我本该更明智（实际没有）”，用来表达后悔。
allow sb to do："They don't allow you to move forward" 意为“它们不让你向前走/取得进展”。
并列宾语："shares three kinds of financial guilt and how to address them" 中 and 连接名词短语与“疑问词+不定式”（how to address them）。

articles.title: Flood death toll in India's Assam reaches 100 as thousands lose their homes
articles.summary: 印度东北部阿萨姆邦连日季风强降雨引发严重洪灾，死亡人数升至 100，数十万人流离失所，救援与重建仍在进行。

sentences.en: GUWAHATI, India — The flood crisis in India's northeastern Assam state remained critical on Monday, with the death toll reaching 100 after two more people died overnight, officials said.
sentences.zh: 印度古瓦哈提——官员表示，周一印度东北部阿萨姆邦的洪灾危机依然严峻，又有两人在夜间遇难，死亡人数达到 100 人。

sentences.en: Several rivers remain above danger levels, raising the risk of fresh flooding in vulnerable areas, the Assam State Disaster Management Authority said.
sentences.zh: 阿萨姆邦灾害管理局表示，多条河流水位仍超过警戒线，增加了脆弱地区再次发生洪灾的风险。

sentences.en: Days of heavy monsoon rain has caused rivers, including the Brahmaputra, to overflow that inundated communities while disrupting livelihoods and damaging infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 连日的强季风降雨导致包括布拉马普特拉河在内的河流泛滥，淹没社区，同时破坏了生计与基础设施。

sentences.en: The river, one of Asia's largest that originates in China's Tibet region and flows about 900 kilometers through Assam, flooded villages, swept away homes and forced nearly 300,000 people into government-run relief camps, officials said.
sentences.zh: 官员说，这条亚洲最大的河流之一发源于中国西藏地区、流经阿萨姆邦约 900 公里，它冲毁村庄、卷走房屋，并迫使近 30 万人进入政府设立的救济营。

sentences.en: The floods that began last month displaced more than 700,000 people and submerged vast stretches of farmland and damaged roads and other local infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 上个月开始的洪水使 70 多万人流离失所，淹没了大片农田，并损毁了道路及其他地方基础设施。

sentences.en: Although many residents have begun returning to their homes as floodwaters recede, at least 49,000 flood-affected residents remain housed in 125 relief camps and relief distribution centers, officials said.
sentences.zh: 官员说，尽管随着洪水退去许多居民已开始返家，但至少 4.9 万名受灾居民仍住在 125 个救济营和物资分发中心。

sentences.en: Authorities remained engaged in relief and monitoring efforts as they assessed the extent of the damage and the needs of affected populations.
sentences.zh: 当局持续开展救援与监测工作，同时评估受损程度及受灾群众的需求。

sentences.en: The floods also devastated livestock, with large numbers of cattle lost, dealing a blow to rural communities and raising concerns about disease outbreaks.
sentences.zh: 洪水还摧毁了牲畜，大量牛只损失，给农村社区造成打击，并引发对疾病暴发的担忧。

sentences.en: Farukuddin Ahmed, a 47-year-old trader from Nazira town in Assam's worst-hit Sivasagar district, said displaced families were slowly returning home, many to rebuild on ground still buried under two to three feet of silt.
sentences.zh: 来自阿萨姆邦受灾最严重锡布萨加尔县纳齐拉镇的 47 岁商人法鲁克丁·艾哈迈德说，流离失所的家庭正慢慢返家，许多人要在仍被两三英尺淤泥覆盖的地面上重建家园。

sentences.en: A nearby village, Nepali Khuti, had about 100 households before the floods. "Only a few houses are left and the rest washed away by the surging flood waters," Ahmed said.
sentences.zh: 附近的尼泊利库蒂村在洪水前约有 100 户人家。艾哈迈德说：“只剩下寥寥几间房屋，其余都被汹涌的洪水冲走了。”

sentences.en: "The residents, mainly dairy farmers, have to rebuild their lives from scratch having lost all their cattle."
sentences.zh: “这些居民主要是奶农，在失去所有牛只后，不得不从零开始重建生活。”

sentences.en: Aid in the form of roofing sheets and other building materials was beginning to arrive, he added.
sentences.zh: 他补充说，以屋顶板和其他建材形式的援助开始抵达。

sentences.en: "We have directed officials to complete damage assessment as soon as possible so the government could provide financial assistance for their rehabilitation," Assam Agriculture and Irrigation Minister Pijush Hazarika said after a review meeting.
sentences.zh: 阿萨姆邦农业与灌溉部长皮尤什·哈扎里卡在会议后说：“我们已指示官员尽快完成损失评估，以便政府能为他们的重建提供财政援助。”

sentences.en: The annual monsoon season frequently triggers flooding in Assam, where swollen rivers inundate large areas and displace thousands of residents each year.
sentences.zh: 每年季风季节都频繁引发阿萨姆邦的洪水，那里暴涨的河流淹没大片地区，每年使数千居民流离失所。

vocab.zh: 严峻的；关键的（此处指局势危急）

grammar: with 复合结构作伴随状语："with the death toll reaching 100" 中 with + 宾语 + 现在分词，表示“随着死亡人数达到 100”。
现在分词作结果状语："raising the risk of fresh flooding" 表示上文情况导致的结果，相当于 which raised...。
cause sb/sth to do："has caused rivers ... to overflow" 意为“导致河流泛滥”；注意主语 days of rain 视为整体，谓语用单数 has。
定语从句 + while doing："rivers, including the Brahmaputra, that inundated communities while disrupting livelihoods" 中 that 修饰 rivers，while disrupting 意为“同时破坏”。
although 让步状语从句 + remain + 过去分词："Although many residents have begun ... at least 49,000 ... remain housed" 中 remain housed 表示“仍处于被安置的状态”。
现在分词完成式作原因状语："having lost all their cattle" 表示“在失去牛只之后/由于失去”，强调动作先于主句发生。
where 引导定语从句："Assam, where swollen rivers inundate..." 中 where 相当于 in which，修饰地点 Assam。

articles.title: Testosterone is having a moment. But who actually needs it?
articles.summary: 社交媒体上“睾酮热潮”愈演愈烈，但泌尿科医生提醒：并非每个男性都需要睾酮疗法，关键在于是否有症状并经规范检测。

sentences.en: A few times, Dr. Jamin Brahmbhatt suspected he might have low testosterone.
sentences.zh: 有几次，贾明·布拉姆巴特医生怀疑自己的睾酮可能偏低。

sentences.en: But when he checked his numbers, he discovered they were within a normal range.
sentences.zh: 但当他检查数值时，发现结果在正常范围内。

sentences.en: "Turns out it was more so my sleep and stress and everything else," says Brahmbhatt, a urologist at Orlando Health in Florida.
sentences.zh: “结果更可能是我的睡眠、压力以及其他因素，”佛罗里达奥兰多健康中心的泌尿科医生布拉姆巴特说。

sentences.en: Brahmbhatt treats men with low testosterone every day — meaning he's on the front lines of the current cultural fixation with testosterone.
sentences.zh: 布拉姆巴特每天诊治睾酮偏低的男性——这意味着他正处于当前睾酮文化热潮的最前线。

sentences.en: Social media is overflowing with testosterone content, from fears of "low T" to "T-maxxing" tutorials.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体上充斥着关于睾酮的内容，从对“低 T”的恐惧到“睾酮最大化”教程。

sentences.en: Influential voices, including the podcaster Joe Rogan and Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., are openly discussing their own use of testosterone therapy.
sentences.zh: 包括播客主持人乔·罗根和卫生部长小罗伯特·肯尼迪在内的有影响力人物，都在公开讨论他们自己对睾酮疗法的使用。

sentences.en: And there's a huge industry of online clinics that make it easy for anyone to get a prescription.
sentences.zh: 还有一个庞大的在线诊所产业，让任何人都能轻松获得处方。

sentences.en: Brahmbhatt welcomes the increased attention to men's health — and hormone replacement therapy specifically — which he says has been "ignored" for too long.
sentences.zh: 布拉姆巴特欢迎人们对男性健康——尤其是激素替代疗法——日益增长的关注，他说这一领域被“忽视”太久了。

sentences.en: But he also sees men who've spent hours in online forums like Reddit, convinced they need testosterone even before they've spoken to a doctor or had their levels tested.
sentences.zh: 但他也看到一些男性在 Reddit 等网络论坛里泡了好几个小时，在还没看过医生或做过激素水平检测之前，就确信自己需要睾酮。

sentences.en: "Not every guy needs to be on it," Brahmbhatt says.
sentences.zh: “不是每个男人都需要用它，”布拉姆巴特说。

sentences.en: "Testosterone has gotten a bad wrap because … you can walk into these clinics, go online, and get a prescription, they don't do all the testing, they don't do the follow up. That is the unsafe territory."
sentences.zh: “睾酮落得坏名声是因为……你走进这些诊所、上网就能拿到处方，它们不做全套检测，也不做后续跟踪。那才是不安全的领域。”

sentences.en: Testosterone is a sex hormone, but its effects on physiology extend well beyond reproduction.
sentences.zh: 睾酮是一种性激素，但它对生理的影响远远超出生殖范畴。

sentences.en: It's also involved in metabolism, bone health, muscle mass, red blood cell production and brain function.
sentences.zh: 它还参与新陈代谢、骨骼健康、肌肉量、红细胞生成以及大脑功能。

sentences.en: Experts in the field emphasize that it's a powerful indicator of overall health.
sentences.zh: 该领域的专家强调，它是整体健康的一个有力指标。

sentences.en: "When levels are low and men are symptomatic, it's not just a testosterone issue, but a men's health issue," says Dr. Helen Bernie, director of Sexual and Reproductive Medicine at Indiana University.
sentences.zh: “当水平偏低且男性出现症状时，这不只是睾酮问题，而是男性健康问题，”印第安纳大学性与生殖医学主任海伦·伯尼医生说。

vocab.zh: 充满；溢出（be overflowing with 充满）

grammar: 省略 that 的宾语从句："he discovered they were within a normal range" 中 discovered 后接省略 that 的从句。
口语省略主句："Turns out it was more so my sleep..." 完整形式为 It turns out (that)...，表示“结果是/原来是”。
现在分词作解释性状语："meaning he's on the front lines" 中 meaning 相当于 which means，引出对前句的补充说明。
make it + adj. + for sb to do："make it easy for anyone to get a prescription" 中 it 为形式宾语，真正宾语是 to get a prescription。
过去分词作状语："convinced they need testosterone" 相当于 who are convinced (that)...，意为“确信……”，作伴随/原因状语。
not just... but... 并列结构："not just a testosterone issue, but a men's health issue" 意为“不只是……而是……”。
extend beyond："extend well beyond reproduction" 中 well 作副词，意为“大大地/远”，表示影响“远远超出”某范围。

articles.title: An AI chatbot is joining the search for art looted by the Nazis
articles.summary: 逾 60 万件艺术品在二战中被纳粹掠夺且大多未归还。圣克拉拉大学团队正用 AI 聊天机器人，帮助家族追溯并寻回这些失落的艺术品。

sentences.en: More than 600,000 artworks and other cultural objects, mostly owned by Jews, were stolen by the Nazis leading up to and during World War II.
sentences.zh: 在二战前夕及期间，逾 60 万件艺术品和其他文化物品（大多为犹太人所有）被纳粹窃取。

sentences.en: But reclaiming these artifacts is often a long and fraught process.
sentences.zh: 但取回这些文物往往是一个漫长而充满波折的过程。

sentences.en: "There's no central repository, no database that's telling you where that art is," said Joel Greenberg, founder of Art Ashes, a nonprofit that helps families track down and recover art looted by the Nazis.
sentences.zh: “没有一个中央资料库、没有哪个数据库能告诉你那些艺术品在哪里，”乔尔·格林伯格说；他是非营利组织 Art Ashes 的创始人，该组织帮助家庭追踪并寻回被纳粹掠夺的艺术品。

sentences.en: On top of locating the missing art, the rightful owners need to prove it was stolen from them in the first place.
sentences.zh: 除了要找到失踪的艺术品，合法所有者还需要证明它最初就是从他们那里被偷走的。

sentences.en: "And then to recreate the historical record of what actually happened to the family and the family's art is also very difficult, because those records, if they exist, are spread among different repositories around the world," Greenberg said.
sentences.zh: “而要重建关于这个家庭及其艺术品究竟遭遇了什么的历史记录，也同样困难，因为那些记录即便存在，也分散在世界各地不同的资料库中，”格林伯格说。

sentences.en: There are dozens of archives containing information about these missing artworks, with holdings in a variety of languages and formats.
sentences.zh: 有数十个档案库保存着关于这些失踪艺术品的信息，其馆藏涵盖多种语言和格式。

sentences.en: A team at Santa Clara University in Silicon Valley is developing a new AI chatbot that could help streamline the complicated process of getting these works back to their owners.
sentences.zh: 硅谷圣克拉拉大学的一个团队正在开发一款新的 AI 聊天机器人，有望简化将这些作品归还所有者的复杂流程。

sentences.en: The AI Provenance Assistant is testing how artificial intelligence could eventually make it easier for people to search archives of stolen art.
sentences.zh: 这款“AI 出处助手”正在测试人工智能最终如何让人们更轻松地检索被掠艺术品的档案。

sentences.en: "We are applying AI tools to make it easier to make the kinds of connections that seasoned researchers would have to spend a long time doing manually," said Santoro.
sentences.zh: “我们正在应用 AI 工具，让那些资深研究者过去要花很长时间手动完成的关联工作变得更容易，”桑托罗说。

sentences.en: Right now, the tool is only scraping records from one database — that of the Jeu de Paume museum in Paris.
sentences.zh: 目前，该工具只从一个数据库抓取记录——那就是巴黎的网球场博物馆（Jeu de Paume）。

sentences.en: The Nazis warehoused tens of thousands of looted artworks at the museum during World War II and kept elaborate records — records now available for anyone to search online.
sentences.zh: 二战期间，纳粹将数万件被掠艺术品存放在该博物馆，并保留了详尽的记录——这些记录如今任何人都能在网上检索。

sentences.en: But Santoro said his team's AI tool is more intuitive than the Jeu de Paume's database because it doesn't require users to deal with drop-down menus and input keywords into boxes.
sentences.zh: 但桑托罗表示，他团队的 AI 工具比网球场博物馆的数据库更直观，因为它不需要用户去处理下拉菜单、把关键词输入方框。

grammar: 被动语态："were stolen by the Nazis" 强调受事（艺术品）而非施事，适合客观报道。
现在分词作时间状语："leading up to and during World War II" 中 leading up to 表示“在……之前的一段时间”，与 during 并列。
定语从句："a nonprofit that helps families track down..." 中 that 修饰 nonprofit；help sb (to) do 结构。
what 引导名词性从句："what actually happened to the family" 作 of 的宾语（介词后用 what 从句）。
make + it(形式宾语) + adj. + for sb to do："make it easier for people to search archives"。
that 引导定语从句："connections that seasoned researchers would have to spend a long time doing manually"。
because 引导原因状语从句："because it doesn't require users to deal with..."，require sb to do 意为“要求某人做某事”。

articles.title: Selling experiences, not things: Services overtake physical goods in downtown retail
articles.summary: 美国市中心正在变化：曾经的服装礼品店让位于健身房、沙龙与餐厅。去年，提供“服务”而非“商品”的零售空间首次超过卖实物的店铺。

sentences.en: America's downtowns are changing. Storefronts that used to showcase clothes or gifts are giving way to gyms and salons.
sentences.zh: 美国的市中心正在改变。曾经展示服装或礼品的临街店面，正让位于健身房和美容沙龙。

sentences.en: Last year marked the first time that more retail space went to shops offering services rather than things.
sentences.zh: 去年标志着一个首次：更多的零售空间流向了提供“服务”而非“实物”的店铺。

sentences.en: On main streets all across the country, retail spaces that used to have shops selling stuff are increasingly leased for food and services.
sentences.zh: 在全国各地的主要街道上，曾经卖东西的零售空间正越来越多地被租去经营餐饮与服务。

sentences.en: In the 20 biggest cities, retail tenants are declining for the third year in a row, while personal services and entertainment are ballooning.
sentences.zh: 在最大的 20 个城市里，零售租户连续第三年减少，而个人服务与娱乐业态却在急剧膨胀。

sentences.en: Over the very long term, consumers have switched a lot of spending from retail goods to services, in terms of share of wallet.
sentences.zh: 从极长期来看，消费者已将大量支出从零售商品转向服务，就消费占比而言。

sentences.en: Consumers don't necessarily need to go to physical spaces to just make a purchase anymore.
sentences.zh: 消费者不再非得去实体场所才能完成一次购买。

sentences.en: Everything is at your fingertips online, which means people who go out to shop are looking for fun, an activity.
sentences.zh: 一切都能在网上触手可及，这意味着出门购物的人追求的是乐趣、是一种活动。

sentences.en: "You can't stroll Amazon," said one local shop owner, capturing why people still value physical stores.
sentences.zh: “你没法在亚马逊上闲逛，”一位本地店主说，这句话道出了人们为何仍看重实体店。

sentences.en: Malls add arcades or gyms as a way to draw people more regularly and remind them they have good stuff.
sentences.zh: 商场增设游戏厅或健身房，以此更频繁地吸引人群，并提醒他们这里有好东西。

sentences.en: The shift in tenants has people conflicted — a dinner or a hair appointment becomes a singular destination, and people don't build in time to wander around.
sentences.zh: 租户结构的变化让人心情复杂——一顿晚餐或一次美发成了一个单一目的地，人们不再留出闲逛的时间。

sentences.en: Local shop owners try to give people reasons to visit in person, rearranging displays every day to keep even loyal customers on their toes.
sentences.zh: 本地店主努力给人们亲自到店的理由，每天重新布置陈列，让即便忠诚的顾客也保持新鲜感。

grammar: 定语从句 + used to："Storefronts that used to showcase... are giving way to..." 中 that 修饰主语，used to do 表示“过去常常”。
the first time 后接 that 从句："the first time that more retail space went to..."（that 可省略）。
被动语态："are increasingly leased for food and services" 中 increasingly 修饰被动，表示“越来越多地被租用于”。
while 表对比："while personal services ... are ballooning" 中 while 连接两个相反趋势的分句，意为“而”。
现在完成时："have switched ... from retail goods to services" 强调至今的影响；switch ... from A to B 结构。
which 非限制性定语从句："Everything is at your fingertips online, which means..." 中 which 指代前面整句。
keep sb on one's toes：固定搭配，意为“使某人保持警觉/新鲜感”。

articles.title: Typhoon Dolphin forces evacuations on China's eastern coast
articles.summary: 台风“海豚”登陆中国东部沿海，约 160 万人接到撤离指令、逾 2600 个航班取消；随后减弱为热带风暴，但暴雨预计持续一周。

sentences.en: About 1.6 million people faced evacuation orders and thousands of flights were canceled as Typhoon Dolphin slammed into China's eastern coast.
sentences.zh: 随着台风“海豚”猛烈袭击中国东部沿海，约 160 万人接到撤离指令，数千个航班被取消。

sentences.en: Typhoon Dolphin made landfall on the east coast of Yuhuan, where a state broadcaster reporter was standing barely able to stay upright.
sentences.zh: 台风“海豚”在玉环东海岸登陆，一名国家电视台记者站在那里几乎难以站稳。

sentences.en: Local authorities have suspended some train services and canceled over 2,600 flights as of Monday morning in multiple cities.
sentences.zh: 截至周一上午，多个城市的地方当局已暂停部分列车服务，并取消了逾 2600 个航班。

sentences.en: Continuous rainfall battered the financial capital, Shanghai, with parts of the downtown flooded.
sentences.zh: 持续的降雨袭击了金融中心上海，市中心部分地区被淹。

sentences.en: By Monday morning, Typhoon Dolphin had weakened to a tropical storm.
sentences.zh: 到周一上午，台风“海豚”已减弱为热带风暴。

sentences.en: But torrential rain that comes along with typhoons is forecast to continue for a whole week, a meteorologist said.
sentences.zh: 一位气象学家表示，但伴随台风而来的暴雨预计将持续整整一周。

sentences.en: "The impact of the rainfall is very wide, and it covers more than 10 provinces and cities," she told state media.
sentences.zh: “降雨的影响范围很广，覆盖超过 10 个省和市，”她对国家媒体说。

sentences.en: She warns there could be flash floods, landslides and mudslides.
sentences.zh: 她警告说，可能会出现山洪、山体滑坡和泥石流。

sentences.en: And typhoons are only going to get more intense with global warming, a science adviser said.
sentences.zh: 一位科学顾问表示，随着全球变暖，台风只会变得更加猛烈。

sentences.en: "We can expect more severe typhoons in the Pacific, and some of those will definitely hit parts of Asia — Japan, Korea, China, the Philippines, Vietnam and so on," he said.
sentences.zh: “我们可以预见太平洋上会出现更强烈的台风，其中一些必然会影响亚洲部分地区——日本、韩国、中国、菲律宾、越南等等，”他说。

sentences.en: In the Philippines, Typhoon Dolphin intensified the monsoon season and forced several ports to close.
sentences.zh: 在菲律宾，台风“海豚”加剧了季风季节，并迫使数个港口关闭。

grammar: as 引导状语从句："as Typhoon Dolphin slammed into..." 中 as 表时间/原因，slam into 意为“猛烈撞击/登陆”。
where 引导非限制性定语从句："where a state broadcaster reporter was standing" 修饰 Yuhuan。
现在完成时："have suspended ... and canceled..." 强调对当前（截至周一晨）的影响；as of 表示“截至”。
with 复合结构："with parts of the downtown flooded" 中 with + 宾语 + 过去分词，作伴随状语，表示“市中心部分被淹”。
过去完成时："had weakened to a tropical storm" 表示在过去某一时间（周一晨）之前已发生的状态变化。
that 引导定语从句："torrential rain that comes along with typhoons" 中 that 修饰 rain；come along with 意为“随……而来”。
be going to 表将来趋势："are only going to get more intense with global warming"，with 介词短语表示“随着全球变暖”。

articles.title: A solar eclipse happens this week. Here is what to know
articles.summary: 本周三，欧洲部分地区与美国多地可观测到一次日食：冰岛、格陵兰、西班牙等地可见全食，美国北部可见偏食。专家提醒务必使用专业护目镜。

sentences.en: People throughout Europe and parts of the U.S. will be treated to a chance to see a solar eclipse on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 本周三，全欧洲与美国部分地区的人们将有幸观测到一次日食。

sentences.en: People in Iceland, Greenland, northern Russia, Spain, and a part of Portugal will see a total eclipse, according to astronomers.
sentences.zh: 据天文学家称，冰岛、格陵兰、俄罗斯北部、西班牙和葡萄牙部分地区的人们将看到日全食。

sentences.en: That's when the moon passes between the Earth and the Sun, fully blocking the Sun's face.
sentences.zh: 那是当月球运行到地球与太阳之间、完全遮住太阳表面的时候。

sentences.en: NASA says northern parts of the United States, including from Alaska to North Carolina, will see a partial solar eclipse.
sentences.zh: 美国宇航局表示，美国北部地区（从阿拉斯加到北卡罗来纳）将看到日偏食。

sentences.en: During a partial solar eclipse, the moon passes between the sun and Earth, but the celestial bodies are not perfectly aligned.
sentences.zh: 在日偏食期间，月球运行于太阳与地球之间，但天体并未完美对齐。

sentences.en: Because only parts of the sun are obscured, the sun appears as a crescent shape.
sentences.zh: 因为只有部分太阳被遮挡，太阳呈现为新月般的形状。

sentences.en: The partial eclipse is expected to begin around 1:17 p.m. ET in Washington, D.C. and have 4% coverage, according to NASA.
sentences.zh: 据美国宇航局称，偏食预计在华盛顿特区东部时间下午 1:17 左右开始，遮挡率达 4%。

sentences.en: This will be the first solar eclipse visible from Spain's mainland since 1905, according to the European Space Agency.
sentences.zh: 据欧洲航天局称，这将是自 1905 年以来首次在西班牙本土可见的日食。

sentences.en: For those who plan to watch either the total or partial eclipse, special equipment such as eclipse glasses will be necessary to protect one's eyes.
sentences.zh: 对于计划观看全食或偏食的人，必须使用日食眼镜等专用设备来保护眼睛。

sentences.en: Looking at the sun, even if for a short time, can cause significant eye damage, including burns and even permanent vision loss.
sentences.zh: 注视太阳，即便只有很短时间，也会造成严重的眼部损伤，包括灼伤甚至永久性视力丧失。

sentences.en: "From our unique perspective on Earth during a total solar eclipse, scientists can study the Sun's corona in a way we can't from anywhere else in the solar system," a NASA manager said.
sentences.zh: “在日全食期间，凭借地球这一独特视角，科学家能以太阳系中其他地方都无法实现的方式研究太阳的日冕，”一位美国宇航局主管说。

grammar: be treated to："will be treated to a chance to see" 意为“有幸体验到”；a chance to see 不定式作定语。
That's when...："That's when the moon passes..." 中 that 指代前文，when 引导表语从句。
according to："according to astronomers" 为插入语，表示信息来源。
because 引导原因状语从句："Because only parts of the sun are obscured" 中 are obscured 为被动语态。
be necessary to do："special equipment ... will be necessary to protect one's eyes" 中不定式表目的。
can cause："Looking at the sun ... can cause significant eye damage" 中动名词短语作主语，cause 后接宾语。
in a way (that)...："in a way we can't from anywhere else" 中省略 that 的定语从句修饰 way。
